threads.summary_md: Matt 10:20's *it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you* + Matt 10:32's confess-me-before-men — read against 4 Maccabees's wisdom-stream architecture in Eleazar's confession and the third son's torture-witness. 4 Maccabees (edition chapter 6, verse 19 = standard 4 Macc 7:19) names the disciples-of-righteousness who confess Yahuah (God) believing unto Yahuah (God) they die not as the patriarchs Avraham (Abraham), Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob) died not. 4 Maccabees (edition chapter 8, verse 18 = standard 4 Macc 9:18) names the operative-fact for Matt 10:20: *even if thou dost remove my organ of speech, Elohim (God) is a hearer also of the speechless.* The framework reads Matt 10:19-20's Ruach-supplied-words-in-the-persecution-encounter architecture as the same wisdom-stream diagnostic — the Father's direct-hearing of the persecuted-disciple does not depend on the disciple's organ of speech; the Father supplies the words when the kingdom-citizen's flesh-capacity reaches its limit.

threads.title: Names written before the Great One and not blotted out — 1 Enoch 103–104 and confessing or denying him
threads.summary_md: *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 10:32). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 10:33). The confessing he promises is a name spoken before the Father, and the library knows the names are already written there. Enoch swears to the righteous what he has read: *That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.* (1 Enoch 103:3). *And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). And a few lines on: *I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). Names are written before, and the only thing scripture ever says can happen to a written name is that it is blotted out, at Sinai when Moses pleads, in David's psalm, and in the promise to Sardis: *He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.* (Revelation 3:5). Confess his name before the Father is the same phrase Matthew 10 uses. The one who lives out the confession keeps a name that was always there; the one who denies him under pressure is risking the blotting, which is why the warning is spoken to those whose names are written and not to anyone else.

threads.title: A man's foes shall be they of his own household — the family torn in the day of destruction
threads.summary_md: *Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword. For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law. And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.* (Matthew 10:34-36). He is quoting Micah, and Micah is describing a day. Enoch describes the same day, and the house is where it tears first: *And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.* (1 Enoch 99:5). Then the blood: *And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood. For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his sons’ sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.* (1 Enoch 100:1-2). The enmity set in the garden between the two seeds does not stop at the front door. Wheat and tares can be born under one roof, and when the Shepherd's voice is heard by one and not the other, the line runs straight through the family. What the King warns his disciples of in this age is the first showing of the division Enoch saw finished in the day of destruction, when the house that would not hear falls on itself.

threads.title: The Twelve Apostles, the plant persecuted, the one delivered — Ascension of Isaiah 4:3
threads.summary_md: Matt 10:1-4's naming of the twelve apostles with Yahudah (Judah) Iscariot listed-with-betrayal-note + Matt 10:16-22's persecution-disclosure to the twelve — read against the Ascension of Isaiah 4:3 prophecy in the Belial-prediction passage of the chapter's mid-section. *Will persecute the plant which the Twelve Apostles of the Beloved have planted. Of the Twelve one will be delivered into his hands.* Two architecture-elements named at the wisdom-stream level in advance: the persecution-of-the-plant (the kingdom-substance the twelve plant in the gathering-mission) and the inner-circle-betrayal (one of the Twelve delivered into the persecutor's hand). The framework reads the Ascension passage as the wisdom-stream's confirmation that the architecture of Matt 10:4 and Matt 10:16-22 is not surprise-development but named-in-advance prophecy of the Belial-pattern operating against the apostolic-mission.

threads.title: The prophet's question and the angel's answer — 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4 on the inaugurated-but-not-yet tension
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:2-3's Yochanan (John)-from-prison question *art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?* AND Matt 11:6's blessing on *whosoever shall not be offended in me* — read against 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:33-37's wisdom-stream architecture of the prophet's-question-from-distress under the inaugurated-but-not-yet tension. 4 Ezra 4:33's *how, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?* names the prophet's timing-question to the angel Uriel; 4 Ezra 4:34's *do not you hasten above the most Highest* names the angel's commendation of the trust-the-timeline disposition; 4 Ezra 4:35's *souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long?* names the souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers asking-how-long architecture (the same pattern Revelation 6:9-11 names at the New Testament restatement with the souls under the altar). The framework reads Yochanan's (John's) prison-question as the legitimate-clarification-seek of a prophet operating with the prophetic-compression now facing the inaugurated-but-not-yet gap. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:6 names the blessing on the disposition that endures the gap.

threads.title: The restoration of the age to come — 1 Enoch 5 and 10, Jubilees 23
threads.summary_md: When John sends from prison to ask whether he is the one, Yahusha (Jesus) answers with what is happening in front of the messengers: *The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.* (Matthew 11:5). It is Isaiah's list: *Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.* (Isaiah 35:5). And it is a taste of an age the library had already described in full. Enoch tells what is kept for the elect once the judgment has passed: *And for you the godless there shall be a curse. But for the elect there shall be light and joy and peace, And they shall inherit the earth.* (1 Enoch 5:7). *And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride: But they who are wise shall be humble.* (1 Enoch 5:8). *And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life. And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life.* (1 Enoch 5:9). The same promise is given to Noah's seed after the Watchers are bound: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). *And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.* (1 Enoch 10:18). Jubilees 23 says the same of the last days, long life, peace and joy, no Satan and no destroyer, and healing. What John's messengers saw was that age reaching back into theirs, the blind and lame and dead already being handled the way the whole earth will be handled. The day of vengeance in the same breath of Isaiah 61 he left unread, because that part waits for his return.

threads.title: Eliyahu ordained to restore the tribes of Jacob — Sirach 48:10 and 1 Maccabees 2:58
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:14's *if ye will receive it, this is Eliyahu (Elijah), which was for to come* identifying Yochanan (John) as the inaugural-Eliyahu-pattern fulfillment — read against the wisdom-stream's strongest verbal-anchor for the Eliyahu-pattern with the twelve-tribe-gathering substance. Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:10 names the Eliyahu-mission explicitly: *ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God) ... to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.* The clause *to restore the tribes of Jacob* locks the twelve-tribe-restoration architecture (Red Line #11) as integral to the Eliyahu-mission at the wisdom-stream register. 1 Maccabees 2:58 names the Eliyahu-zealous-for-the-Torah architecture: *Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.* The framework reads Yochanan (John) as the inaugural-Eliyahu-pattern-fulfillment — messenger-before-the-King's-first-coming, with the dreadful-day-of-Yahuah (the LORD) full-restoration-of-the-twelve-tribes reserved for the second-coming. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture with the twelve-tribe substance integrated; Matt 11:13-14 names the inaugural-fulfillment.

threads.title: The new heart, the cleansing spirit, and the children of the living Elohim — Jubilees 1:23-25
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:11's *he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he* (the kingdom-citizens' transformation-of-status exceeding the highest of the prophetic-tradition) — read against Jubilees 1:23-25's wisdom-stream Tanakh-anchor parallel to Jeremiah 31:33 and Ezekiel 36:26-27. Three direct moves: Jubilees 1:23 names the heart-circumcision and the creation of the holy-spirit and the cleansing-that-does-not-turn-away (the new-heart Tanakh-promise); Jubilees 1:24 names the souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah (God) and the fulfilling-of-the-commandments and the Father-and-children-relation (the substance of the new-heart); Jubilees 1:25 names the *children of the living Elohim (God)* designation — the same phrase Hosea 1:10 names for the Lo-Ammi scattered-seed gathered-home and the same phrase Paul cites at Romans 9:25-26. The framework reads the verse-cluster as one architecture: the new-heart-Spirit-cleansing substance produces the scattered-seed gathered-home as children-of-the-living-Elohim (God). Matt 11:11 names the operative-fact of the architecture coming-to-pass at the kingdom's inauguration — what the prophets served from outside the indwelling-Ruach (Spirit), the kingdom-citizens carry from inside it.

threads.title: The wise lying in wait for the righteous, condemning him with a shameful death — Wisdom of Solomon 2:12-20
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:16-19's children-in-the-marketplaces diagnostic — the system rejected Yochanan (John) for austerity AND rejected Yahusha (Jesus) for festivity, opposite-direction-complaints from one prior-decision-against-responding — read against Wisdom of Solomon 2:12-20's wisdom-stream prophecy of the system's-rejection-of-the-righteous-one. Three direct moves: Wisdom 2:12 names the lying-in-wait-because-the-righteous-upbraids-us-with-our-offending-the-law; Wisdom 2:15 names the aesthetic-rejection *his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion*; Wisdom 2:20 names the trajectory toward *condemn him with a shameful death.* The framework reads the verse-cluster as the wisdom-stream pre-figuration of the full architecture Matt 11:18-19 walks at its inaugural-step: the *gluttonous-man, winebibber, friend-of-publicans-and-sinners* slander is the moral-character-attack the wisdom-stream had named in advance. The same architecture operates in the present-age against the heart-Torah-walking kingdom-citizens — institutional Christianity's *legalism* slander and modern Hebrew Roots' *exclusivism* slander are different costumes on the same Wisdom 2 architecture.

threads.title: Wisdom's come-unto-me invitation, the wisdom given to Yashar'el, and the law that endureth for ever — Sirach 24 and Baruch 3-4
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:19's *wisdom is justified of her children* closing — the kingdom-citizens-whose-ears-the-Father-has-opened recognize the heart-Torah-substance underneath both Yochanan's (John's) austerity and Yahusha's (Jesus's) festivity — read against the wisdom-stream's wisdom-personification-tradition and the Torah-as-wisdom anchor in Sirach 24 and Baruch 3-4. Three moves: Sirach 24:19 names the wisdom-figure's *come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits* universal-invitation (the typological-anchor of the Matt 11:28's King's come-unto-me invitation later in the chapter); Baruch 3:36 names the wisdom *given to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved*; Baruch 4:1 identifies the wisdom-given as *the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever* — the wisdom-stream's direct equation of wisdom with the Torah. The framework reads the cluster as a load-bearing wisdom-stream anchor against the institutional-Christian antinomian-reading: the wisdom-given to Yashar'el (Israel) IS the Torah; the Torah endures for ever; the children-of-wisdom at Matt 11:19 are the kingdom-citizens-who-keep-the-commandments.

threads.title: A sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places; mighty men shall be mightily tormented — Wisdom of Solomon 6:5-8
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:20-24's woes upon Korazin, Beit-Tsaida (Bethsaida), and Kfar-Nachum (Capernaum) with the *more tolerable for Tyre and Tsidon (Sidon) / for Sodom* graduated-accountability-architecture — read against Wisdom of Solomon 6:5-8's wisdom-stream articulation of the principle. Three direct moves: Wisdom 6:5 names *a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places*; Wisdom 6:6 names *mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented* — the wisdom-stream's direct statement of the graduated-accountability-by-credentialing-density principle; Wisdom 6:8 names *a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.* The framework reads the verse-cluster against the King's *more tolerable for Sodom* / *more tolerable for Tyre and Tsidon (Sidon)* operative-application: Kfar-Nachum (Capernaum) the *exalted-unto-heaven* (the King's ministry-base, the Matt 9:1 *his own city*) is the *mighty* upon whom the sore-trial falls. The framework's reading rules out both the inherited eternal-conscious-torment monolith AND the universalism-flatten — the day-of-judgment is real with real-graduated-degrees, and the credentialing-density determines the degree.

threads.title: Sodom as the enduring judgment-archetype — Jubilees 16:5-9 and Wisdom of Solomon 10:6-8
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:23-24's *more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of Sodom-as-the-enduring-judgment-archetype. Three moves: Jubilees 16:5 names the direct destruction-narrative — Yahuah (God) executed judgment on Sodom, Gomorrah, Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, burning them with fire-and-brimstone until-this-day; Jubilees 16:6 names the architectural-application — *Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom* (Sodom as template for future-judgments); Wisdom of Solomon 10:7 names the enduring-monument — *the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and ... a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 11:23-24: the King invokes the most-canonical-judgment-archetype to lock the graduated-accountability for Kfar-Nachum (Capernaum). Sodom is the floor; the cities-that-saw-the-credential-and-rejected face the sharper application. The framework's reading of *hell* as *hadēs* / *Sheol* (the underworld of the dead, the Tanakh's *Sheol* substance) rules out the inherited Christian eternal-conscious-torment overlay.

threads.title: The Son of Adam named before the Head of Days, revealing the treasures of that which is hidden — 1 Enoch 46-48 beside Matthew 11:25-27
threads.summary_md: *At that time Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Yahuah (Lord) of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.* (Matthew 11:25), and then: *All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.* (Matthew 11:27). Hidden, then revealed, and revealed by the Son to whom he chooses. Enoch watched that same arrangement in heaven. He saw the Father, with a head of days and hair white like wool, and beside him one whose face was like a man's and full of grace (1 Enoch 46:1), and was told who he was: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). The Son himself was hidden first: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). And the ones he is shown to are not the wise of this world: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). The babes of the prayer are the holy and righteous of the Parable, the ones the Father preserved and chose to show his Son to. What Enoch saw in a vision, the Word made flesh says out loud on a road in Galilee, thanking the Father for working exactly that way.

threads.title: Many are in high place, of renown — but mysteries are revealed to the meek — Sirach 3:18-20 and Wisdom of Solomon 7:7
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:25's *I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* — read against THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the inverse-revelation-economy pair. Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:19 names the precise verbal-formulation: *many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed to the meek* — the same inverse-pair (high-place / mysteries) and the same destination-shift (revealed to the meek, not to those in high place) the King names at Matt 11:25. Sirach 3:18 anchors the architectural-logic — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God)* — humility-before-Yahuah (God) is the precondition for the favour Yahuah (God) channels. Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 names the prayer-channel for the spirit-of-wisdom — *I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me* — anchoring Matt 11:25-27's prayer-as-the-channel-for-the-revelation-economy. The wisdom-stream and the King name one diagnostic across two registers: the *meek* of Sirach 3:19 and the *babes* (*nēpioi*) of Matt 11:25 are one body — the *poor in spirit* of Matt 5:3, the *anawim*-disposition the Father's sovereign-revelation channels to.

threads.title: Put your neck under the yoke; behold I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest — Sirach 51:23-27, Sirach 6:24-31, Sirach 24:19
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:28-30's *come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light* — read against THE strongest extras-tier verbal-anchor in the entire Hebrew library: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 51:23-27's wisdom-figure-invitation. Five moves: Sirach 51:23 names *draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning* (the come-unto-me invitation to those-without-credential); Sirach 51:26 names *put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction* (the direct verbal-anchor for Matt 11:29's *take my yoke upon you, and learn of me*); Sirach 51:27 names *behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest* (the direct verbal-anchor for Matt 11:30's *for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light*); Sirach 6:28 names *at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy* (the rest-yielded-by-the-yoke-of-wisdom architecture, the second Sirach yoke-passage at Sirach 6:24-31); Sirach 24:19 names *come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits* (the third major wisdom-figure-come-unto-me invitation). The framework reads the cluster as locking the framework's reading of Matt 11:28-30 against the institutional-Christian antinomian-misuse: the contrast is NOT yoke-vs-no-yoke (Torah-abolition); the contrast is the Pharisaic-oral-tradition-yoke vs the King's-heart-Torah-yoke. The King's yoke IS the Father's-Torah-internalized (Jeremiah 31:33 / Ezekiel 36:26-27); the wisdom-stream wisdom-yoke and the King's heart-Torah-yoke are the same yoke-substance; the rest-promised under both is the rest-of-walking-in-the-good-way Jeremiah 6:16 named. Three wisdom-figure-come-unto-me invitations in Sirach (chapters 6, 24, 51) point forward to one Word-made-flesh issuing the invitation in person at Matt 11:28-30.

threads.title: The Shabbat as covenant-sign and protected-day with life-saving-defense override — Jubilees 2, Jubilees 50, and 1 Maccabees 2
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:1-14's Shabbat-controversies — the disciples-plucking-grain at vv.1-8 with the *Son of Adam is Lord even of the Shabbat* declaration AND the synagogue-Shabbat-healing of the man-with-the-withered-hand at vv.9-14 with the *kal vachomer* sheep-rescue argument at vv.11-12 — read against the wisdom-stream's Shabbat-substance architecture. Four moves: Jubilees 2:17 names the Shabbat as the *great sign* of the covenant — the same covenant-sign substance Exodus 31:13 names; Jubilees 2:21 names the Shabbat as the day-of-eating-and-drinking-and-blessing — explicitly the opposite of the Pharisaic-fence-architecture's reading of restrictive-against-eating; Jubilees 50:12 names the late-Jubilees Shabbat-prohibition code that documents the Second-Temple stringency the Pharisaic-fence inherited and intensified; 1 Maccabees 2:41 names the Hasmonean Shabbat-defense decision that life-saving-overrides-Shabbat-restriction was the operative-principle the wisdom-stream itself had locked under threat of extinction. The framework reads the cluster as locking the framework's reading of Matt 12:1-14 against the institutional-Christian Sunday-Law tradition: the King restores the Shabbat-substance against both the Pharisaic-fence-architecture AND any reading that takes *Lord of the Shabbat* as authorization to abolish what the wisdom-stream witnesses as the covenant-sign Yahuah (God) himself established at Bereshit (Genesis) 2:3 and Exodus 31:13.

threads.title: Mercy as the true offering and alms as deliverance from death — the second Hosea 6:6 citation in framework-register, Sirach 34-35 and Tobit 4
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:7's second Hosea 6:6 citation in Matthew — *if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless* — read against the wisdom-stream's mercy-as-true-offering and alms-as-deliverance-from-death architecture. Three moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 35:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct mercy-substance-IS-the-true-sacrifice architecture — *he that keepeth the law bringeth offerings enough*; Sirach 34:18 names the heart-substance-required-for-the-sacrifice-to-be-accepted architecture — sacrifice without mercy-substance is rejected; Tobit 4:10 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the mercy-as-substance-with-eternal-weight architecture — *alms doth deliver from death, and shall not suffer thee to come into darkness.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of Hosea 6:6 that locks the framework's reading of Matt 12:7 against any reading of mercy as a soft-side of the Torah: mercy is the operative-substance with eternal-weight; the credential-without-substance (the Pharisaic Shabbat-fence-adherence-without-mercy) is the rejected-offering at every register from the wisdom-stream to the gospel. The same Hosea 6:6 diagnostic from Matt 9:13 (table-fellowship-with-sinners) lands again at Matt 12:7 (Shabbat-keeping-without-mercy) — one diagnostic across both Pharisaic counterfeit-righteousness controversies.

threads.title: The righteous stands in boldness before those who condemned him — Wisdom 5 and 1 Enoch 95
threads.summary_md: *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.* (Matthew 12:14). A council of the religious sits to condemn a righteous man, and the verdict it reaches stands for a season. The Wisdom of Solomon had already written the day that verdict is turned over: *then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him* (the Wisdom of Solomon 5:1), and the men who condemned him are made to say out loud what they got wrong: *We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour: How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!* (the Wisdom of Solomon 5:4-5). Enoch pronounces the woe on that council and on every one like it, and says the sentence will fall on them in the same coin: *Woe to you, lying witnesses, And to those who weigh out injustice, For suddenly shall ye perish. Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:6-7). The road from questioning his disciples over dinner, to calling him a glutton and a friend of sinners, to plotting his death, is the road the lying witnesses walk, and it ends at the cross. But the resurrection is the first turning of the verdict, and the day of judgement is the last. The same thing happens to the seed who keep his commandments today, condemned by councils that hold the pulpit, and the same reversal is waiting for them.

threads.title: The Spirit-anointed Elect One — the spirit of wisdom and the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Son in 1 Enoch 49 and 62
threads.summary_md: Matthew explains the King's quiet ministry by quoting Isaiah: *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.* (Matthew 12:18). The prophet's own words are these: *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* (Isaiah 42:1). Isaiah had already said what that Spirit would be: *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);* (Isaiah 11:2). Enoch saw the same Spirit on the same chosen one and calls him by Isaiah's word, the Elect One. *For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.* (1 Enoch 49:1). *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* (1 Enoch 49:3). And when he is seated to judge: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). Isaiah's servant, Enoch's Elect One, and the man the Spirit came down on at the Jordan are one. In this age the anointing shows itself in the way Matthew goes on to describe, a bruised reed he will not break and no voice raised in the streets. At the throne of glory it shows itself as the word of his mouth bringing judgment to victory, which is where Matthew's quotation ends and where Enoch's Parable sits.

threads.title: Compassion on the bruised and the cry of the widow and orphan — the bruised-reed mercy-substance — Sirach 4 and 35
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:20's *a bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the compassion-on-the-bruised-and-the-cry-of-the-widow-and-orphan architecture. Three moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 4:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct kingdom-citizens' disposition — do not defraud-the-poor, do not make-the-needy-eyes-wait, do not make-the-hungry-soul-sorrowful, do not provoke-the-man-in-distress; Sirach 4:4-5 names the compassion-disposition — do not reject-the-supplication, do not turn-the-face-away, do not turn-the-eye-from-the-needy; Sirach 35:13-14 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the cry-of-the-bruised-heard-by-Yahuah (God) architecture — *he will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she poureth out her complaint. Do not the tears run down the widow's cheek? and is not her cry against him that causeth them to fall?* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:20: the mercy-substance the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 42 prophet names of the King is the same substance the wisdom-stream named as the disposition required of the kingdom-citizens. The Pharisaic-system's pattern of categorical-classification-and-dismissal of the bruised-and-the-smoking inverts both the wisdom-stream-disposition and the King's-disposition; the King restores, the system breaks-and-snuffs, and the system's plot at Matt 12:14 is precisely the act-causing-the-tears Sirach 35:14 had named.

threads.title: The binding of the Watchers — Azazel bound hand and foot, and the strong man bound
threads.summary_md: *But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you. Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* (Matthew 12:28-29). The picture of a strong one bound so that his house can be plundered was not drawn fresh for the Pharisees. It is how the Watchers were dealt with, and the library had told it in detail: *And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light. And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* (1 Enoch 10:4-6). The chains were not for him alone: *And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.* (1 Enoch 54:5). Jubilees tells why there are still spirits to cast out at all: *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* (Jubilees 10:11). The devils Yahusha (Jesus) drives out are that tenth, the loose remainder of a host already mostly in chains, and the one they serve is the strong man whose binding is still ahead: *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years, And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.* (Revelation 20:2-3). When the King empties a man of a devil by the Spirit, the house is being spoiled by the one who has the authority to bind its master. That is why he could say the kingdom had come upon them.

threads.title: No forgiveness for the hardened heart — Jubilees 15, 1 Enoch 65, Wisdom of Solomon 12
threads.summary_md: *And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.* (Matthew 12:32). The men he says this to have just watched the Spirit cast out a demon and called it the work of Beelzebub. They saw the thing clearly and named it the devil's, and that is the hardening the library already knew had no road back from it. Enoch was told it about the ones who had learned the Watchers' secrets and would not turn: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). Jubilees names the same wrath for the ones who set the covenant aside on purpose: *there will be great wrath from Yahuah (the Lord) ... because they have forsaken His covenant and have turned aside from His word* (Jubilees 15:33-34). And the Wisdom of Solomon says why the patience ran out on the Canaanites: he gave them place for repentance, not being ignorant that their malice was bred in them and that their way of thinking would never change (Wisdom of Solomon 12:10). None of these is about a slip of the tongue. They are about a settled refusal, eyes open, that has made up its mind against the correction. That is why the one who fears he has committed this sin almost certainly has not; the fear is a conscience still working, and a hardened heart does not lie awake over it.

threads.title: The tongue as the trial of men — the fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed — Sirach 27 and Wisdom of Solomon 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:33-37's tree-by-its-fruit / out-of-the-abundance-of-the-heart-the-mouth-speaketh / every-idle-word eschatological-accountability cluster — read against the wisdom-stream's tongue-as-trial-of-the-heart architecture. Three moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 27:6 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the tree-by-fruit / utterance-by-heart architecture — *the fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man*; Sirach 27:7 names speech-as-the-trial-of-men — *praise no man before thou hearest him speak; for this is the trial of men*; Wisdom of Solomon 1:11 names the no-word-goes-for-nought-and-the-mouth-that-belieth-slays-the-soul architecture — *no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:33-37: the wisdom-stream had named the words-are-fruit-of-the-heart architecture in precisely the substance the King walks at Matt 12:33-35; the day-of-judgment at Matt 12:36 is the cosmic-version of the speech-as-trial architecture Sirach 27:7 had named — the words-spoken are the evidence-of-the-heart-substance the judgment will weigh. *By thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned* (Matt 12:37) walks the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the eternal-weight register.

threads.title: Resurrection from Sheol — the gates of the dead give back what they received — the sign of Yonah in Wisdom of Solomon 16, 1 Enoch 51, Jubilees 23
threads.summary_md: They ask for a sign and he gives them one they cannot see yet: *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* (Matthew 12:40). Three days and three nights in the heart of the earth means Sheol, and coming out of it means Sheol gave him back, and the library had been saying for a long time that Sheol will give back. Solomon says it of Yahuah (God): *thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again* (Wisdom of Solomon 16:13). Enoch says it of the day the Elect One takes the throne: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). Jubilees promises the servants that *the Lord will heal His servants, And they shall rise up and see great peace* (Jubilees 23:30). The sign of Yonah is the King announcing that he himself will go down through those gates first and be brought up, the firstfruits of what Enoch saw the earth and Sheol do for everyone entrusted to them. The count is a real count. Three days and three nights is what he said, and the Friday evening to Sunday morning the tradition settled on does not hold three nights, which is one more reason to read the week of his death by the calendar of the feasts rather than by the calendar handed down.

threads.title: Adam and the inherited evil-heart needing the new-heart cleansing — the empty-house parable architecture — 2 Esdras 7 and Jubilees 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:43-45's unclean-spirit-returning empty-house parable — *when the unclean spirit is gone out of a man ... when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished. Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself ... and the last state of that man is worse than the first* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Adam-inherited-evil-heart needing the new-heart-cleansing. Three moves: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:48 names the inherited-from-Adam architecture — *O Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee*; 2 Esdras 7:118 restates the architecture explicitly; Jubilees 1:23 names the wisdom-stream's direct Tanakh-anchor parallel to Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33 and Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 — *I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:43-45: the cleansed-house empty-of-the-new-heart is the architecture Jubilees 1:23's new-heart-and-holy-spirit-and-cleansing-substance describes by its negative-correlate — deliverance-without-internal-replacement leaves the children-of-Adam without the internal-substance, vulnerable to deeper bondage. The institutional-Christian altar-call-without-Torah-substance conversion-pattern walks the same structural-vulnerability — old bondage removed, new house left empty because the antinomian-reading of the gospel that produced the conversion removed the heart-Torah-walking life as the internal-furnishing the new-heart-substance places. Kefa's (Peter's) apostolic restatement at 2 Peter 2:20-21 names the same architecture: *the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.*

threads.title: Children of Elohim by doing the Father's will — the son-of-the-Most-High identity-marker — Wisdom of Solomon 2, Sirach 4, Jubilees 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:46-50's kingdom-family-redefinition closing — *whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother* — read against the wisdom-stream's children-of-Elohim-by-doing-the-Father's-will architecture. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:13-15 names the child-of-Elohim-by-the-righteous-disposition architecture — *he calleth himself the child of Yahuah (the Lord) ... his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion*; Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 names the son-of-Elohim-tested-by-deliverance architecture — *if the just man be the son of Elohim (God), he will help him*; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 4:10 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the doing-the-Father's-substance-makes-thee-a-son architecture — *be as a father unto the fatherless ... so shalt thou be as the son of the most High*; Jubilees 1:24 names the souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah-and-fulfilling-the-commandments yields the Father-and-children-relation architecture — *they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:50: the kingdom-family-recognition-criterion is the same doing-the-Father's-will substance the wisdom-stream had named as the operative-form of the son-of-the-Most-High identity. The same criterion is the kingdom-entry-criterion at Matt 7:21 (*not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father*), and the 1 John 2:3-4 master-filter restates it: *if we keep his commandments.* The wisdom-stream and the gospel name one architecture across two registers — the kingdom-family is identified by the heart-Torah-walking-disposition the prophets named, the wisdom-stream named, and the King names operative in the kingdom's inauguration.

threads.title: Wisdom hidden from the wicked and revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 48, 2 Esdras 5, Wisdom of Solomon 1, and Sirach 39 beside Matthew 13:10-17
threads.summary_md: When the disciples ask why he speaks to the crowds in parables, Yahusha (Jesus) answers with a passive verb: *He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* (Matthew 13:11). It has been given, before the hearing, and then he quotes Isaiah 6: *they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.* The giving comes first, and the hearing shows who received it. Enoch was shown the same order at the fountain of wisdom: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). The Son is revealed to the holy and righteous whose lot the Father preserved, according to his good pleasure. The rest of the library says it from the other side. The Wisdom of Solomon warns that *into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin* (Wisdom of Solomon 1:4). Ezra is told that in the last days wisdom and understanding withdraw into their secret chamber and are sought of many and not found (2 Esdras 5:9-10). Sirach says the spirit of understanding is poured out on the scribe when the great Yahuah (LORD) wills it (Ecclesiasticus 39:6). The Father does not slam a door on anyone; the soul that loves its sin closes itself, and wisdom, meeting the closed door, passes by. So the disciples do not earn the mysteries by being clever, and the crowd does not lose them by being dull. The ones who hear were given to hear, and the hearing reveals what was already true of them. That is what he means when he says elsewhere that his sheep hear his voice.

threads.title: The fowls that devour the seed — Mastema's birds and the spirits of the Watchers
threads.summary_md: In the parable the seed by the wayside is lost when *fowls came and devoured them up* (Matthew 13:4), and the King does not leave the birds as scenery. He tells us who they are: *When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.* (Matthew 13:19). Jubilees had already put birds in the adversary's hand, sent against the seed in the days of Abraham's father: *Prince Mastema sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, so as to rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked it from the surface of the ground* (Jubilees 11:11). And Enoch names the spirits that do the robbing, where they came from and what they are working toward: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). Abraham drove the fowls off his sacrifice (Genesis 15:11); Mastema sent them against the furrows; the wicked one sends them against the heart where the word of the kingdom has just been sown. It is one enemy with one aim, to take the seed before it can root, and the same birds come back later in the chapter to lodge in the branches of the mustard tree, because what grows in the field grows with the enemy still working in it until the harvest.

threads.title: The seed of good and evil sown in the heart of Adam — 2 Esdras 4, 2 Esdras 3, and 2 Esdras 8
threads.summary_md: Matt 13:24-30's wheat-and-tares parable — *the kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct parallel of the seed-of-good-and-evil sown-in-the-heart-of-Adam architecture. Three moves: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:30 names THE direct wisdom-stream parallel — *the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing shall come?*; 2 Esdras 3:21-22 names the wicked-heart-inherited-from-Adam architecture — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him*; 2 Esdras 8:6 names the prayer-for-seed-unto-the-heart and culture-to-the-understanding so-that-fruit-may-come. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct restatement of the wheat-and-tares architecture at the heart-of-Adam register: the evil-seed was-sown-from-the-beginning AND the time-of-threshing-and-sorting-is-coming AND Yahuah-is-asked-for-seed-unto-the-heart that fruit-may-come. The King at Matt 13:24-30 names the operative-parable-form: the Sower sowing-good-seed in the field; the enemy sowing-tares-while-men-slept; the wheat-and-tares grow-together-until-the-harvest; the harvest-time the tares-burned-and-the-wheat-gathered. The framework reads the architecture WITHOUT collapsing into the Augustinian-original-sin doctrine in its Christian-developed-form: the framework preserves the actor's-responsibility (the watchful-guard-fails per Matt 13:25's *while men slept*) without erasing it; the wisdom-stream knew the inherited-heart-architecture without the Christian-doctrinal-overlay.

threads.title: The Watchers' corruption as tares sown in the wheat — 1 Enoch 6, 10, 15 and Jubilees 5, 7 beside Matthew 13:25-39
threads.summary_md: *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.* (Matthew 13:25). When the disciples ask what it means, Yahusha (Jesus) says the tares are a seed with a father: *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.* (Matthew 13:38-39). Enoch records the sowing. *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* (1 Enoch 6:2). Two hundred of them swore it on Hermon in the days of Jared, and what they begot was a line, not a mood: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): 'Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). Their bodies died in the flood but their spirits stayed: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). Jubilees is the second witness: *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1), and Noah tells his sons that the flood came *owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.* (Jubilees 7:21). So the children of the wicked one are a seed sown into the world, and the parable is not a figure of speech about bad attitudes. But hold the other half of it just as firmly. The seed runs inside every people, not along the lines of any nation or color, and Eli's own sons were sons of Belial; nobody can sort the field by looking at it. That is why the servants are told to let both grow together. The sorting belongs to the reapers at the harvest, and to no one else.

threads.title: Bound and cast into the furnace of fire — the Watchers' judgement and the tares
threads.summary_md: *The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* (Matthew 13:41-42). The tares are gathered first and bound in bundles to burn, and the reapers are angels. Enoch had watched the same angels do the same work on the Watchers: *And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated. In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:12-13). The Parables name the hands that carry them there and the day it happens: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6). And the Animal Apocalypse shows the order of it at the end, the fallen stars first and then the shepherds who destroyed the sheep: *And the judgement was held first over the stars, and they were judged and found guilty, and went to the place of condemnation, and they were cast into an abyss, full of fire and flaming, and full of pillars of fire. And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:24-25). The burning furnace of the parable is this abyss. The angels who bound Azazel in the desert are the angels sent at the harvest, and what they gather out of the kingdom goes where the Watchers went. The seed sown by the enemy is dealt with the same way the enemy's own hosts were dealt with, and before the wheat is brought in.

threads.title: The righteous shall shine as the sun in the kingdom of their Father — 1 Enoch 104, 2 Esdras 7, Wisdom of Solomon 3
threads.summary_md: When the King explains the tares he ends with what the wheat will look like once the field is cleared: *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43). Daniel heard it first: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3). And the rest of the library says it in the same words. Enoch, to the righteous who have been shamed: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* (1 Enoch 104:2). Ezra is shown the orders of the righteous after death, and *the sixth order, when it is shewed them how their face shall shine as the sun, and how they shall be made like unto the light of the stars, being henceforth incorruptible* (2 Esdras 7:97), and later that *the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars* (2 Esdras 7:125). Solomon sets the shining on the day of visitation, in harvest language: *in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:7). Sparks among the stubble is the same picture as the parable, the righteous bright against the burning tares on the day the two are separated. The shining belongs to the wheat that was gathered and came through the sifting with fruit on it, and the King says so by putting the sentence where he puts it, right after the tares are bound and burned.

threads.title: Mysteries hidden from the foundation of the world revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 46 and 48, Wisdom of Solomon 6, 2 Esdras 6
threads.summary_md: *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:* (Matthew 13:34) *That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.* (Matthew 13:35). The psalm he is fulfilling is Asaph's, and the pattern of things hidden since the foundation and then opened to a chosen few runs all through the library. Enoch saw the one who does the opening, and was told who he is: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). He was himself the first thing hidden: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). Solomon speaks the same way as a teacher: *as for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you* (Wisdom of Solomon 6:22), and Ezra is told of the last days when *the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared* (2 Esdras 6:28). So when the King speaks in parables to the crowd and opens them to the disciples, he is doing the work Enoch saw the Son of Adam doing, revealing the treasures of what was hidden, and the disciples receive it because, as he had just told them from Isaiah 6, it was given to them to receive. The sower of the good seed in the next verse is this same Son of Adam.

threads.title: The kingdom of supreme worth as treasure and pearl — Sirach 6, Sirach 20, Wisdom of Solomon 7
threads.summary_md: Matt 13:44-46's hidden-treasure-and-pearl-of-great-price parables — *the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field ... the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the supreme-worth treasure-and-finding-of-incomparable-substance architecture. Four moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 20:30 names *wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?* (the hidden-treasure substance and the finding-and-using-it imperative); Sirach 6:14-15 names *a faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure ... nothing doth countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable* (the supreme-worth and incomparable-value substance); Wisdom of Solomon 7:8-9 names *I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her ... all gold in respect of her is as a little sand* (the wisdom-preferred-above-all-else); Wisdom of Solomon 7:14 names *she is a treasure unto men that never faileth.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the supreme-worth-substance the King's parables name. Short.md walks the framework's preferred reading: the Father-Son-buyer-finds-the-treasure substance — the Sower of vv.36-43 is the Son of Adam; the field is the world; the treasure-hid-in-the-field is the elect-treasure scattered through the field-of-the-world; the buyer is the Father / the Son who finds-and-rejoices-and-pays-the-full-price-to-obtain (per Isaiah 43:4 + Philippians 2:6-8). The framework reads the wisdom-stream cluster in continuity with the framework's preferred reading: the supreme-worth-of-the-treasure operates at every register from the wisdom-stream through the King's parables; the Father-Son-buyer-finds-the-elect-treasure preserves the cause-and-effect Red Line #11 established at vv.10-17 (the Father finds the elect; the elect did-not-find-the-Father-by-their-own-initiative; the kingdom-citizens' supreme-prioritization-of-the-kingdom is the response-substance flowing from the belonging-already-conferred, not the causal-mechanism of the belonging).

threads.title: Wheat from chaff and righteous from wicked at the day of separation — 2 Esdras 7 and 8, 1 Enoch 100, and Wisdom of Solomon 3 beside Matthew 13:47-50
threads.summary_md: *the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away. So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just* (Matthew 13:47-49). The dragnet says from the sea what the wheat and tares said from the field a few verses earlier: everything is gathered, and then the angels do the sorting, and not before. Ezra was shown the day the sorting happens, when *the most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end: But judgment only shall remain* (2 Esdras 7:33-34), and he was told how the count comes out: *many be created, but few shall be saved* (2 Esdras 8:3). Enoch was shown the same day from the other side of it, from where the righteous stand while the angels go to work on the sinners: *In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, And the El Elyon (Most High) will arise on that day of judgement To execute great judgement amongst sinners.* (1 Enoch 100:4), *And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.* (1 Enoch 100:5). The good are gathered into vessels and kept; the bad are cast away; and the righteous who have been asleep in the dust the whole time have nothing to fear from the day. What comes after the sorting is the reign, when the Wisdom of Solomon says of the righteous that *they shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:8). That is the gathered remnant serving as a kingdom of priests to the nations left after the judgement. The net, the seat of judgement, the guardians over the righteous and the dominion of the saints are one day told four ways.

threads.title: The seed war from Genesis 3 forward, with the devil as the source of death — Wisdom of Solomon 2:24, 1 Enoch 22, Jubilees 4
threads.summary_md: *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38). *The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.* (Matthew 13:39). Two seeds in one field, and the devil the one who sowed the second. The library had been saying this since the garden. Solomon names the devil as the source of death itself: *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:24). The first fruit of that seed was Cain, and Enoch was shown his brother's spirit still crying out: *I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.* (1 Enoch 22:5). *Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’* (1 Enoch 22:6). *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). Abel's suit is against a seed, not only a man. Jubilees tells the murder the way Genesis does, *Qayin (Cain) slew Hevel (Abel) because (God) accepted the sacrifice of Hevel (Abel), and did not accept the offering of Qayin (Cain) ... and his blood cried from the ground to heaven* (Jubilees 4:2), and John names which seed Cain was: *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.* (1 John 3:12). So the parable is not a new idea about the world. The serpent in the garden, the envy that brought death in, the Watchers' corruption, the tares in the field, and the harvest where the angels sort them are one story, and Abel's voice has been making suit through all of it until the seed that killed him is gone from among the seed of men.

threads.title: The Eliyahu-pattern prophet's zeal and promised return — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48
threads.summary_md: Matt 14:1-12's beheading of Yochanan (John) the Witness at Herod-Antipas's hand — *Herod had laid hold on Yochanan (John), and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife. For Yochanan (John) said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Eliyahu-pattern prophet's-fiery-zeal-at-the-royal-court and promised-return architecture. Four moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:1 names *then stood up Eliyahu (Elias) the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp* (the prophet's-fiery-zeal at the Achav (Ahab)-Yezevel (Jezebel) royal-court); Sirach 48:2 names *who brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number* (the Eliyahu-pattern judgment-on-the-Torah-violating-court); Sirach 48:10 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Malakhi (Malachi) 4:5-6 promised-return — *who wast ordained for reproofs in their times ... and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob)* (the framework reads in two-fold structure per voice-skill: Yochanan (John) the first-Eliyahu-coming preparing for the King's-first-arrival; the eschatological-second-Eliyahu of Revelation 11 preparing for the second-coming); Sirach 48:11 names *blessed are they that saw thee, and slept in love; for we shall surely live* (the prophet's-disciples-blessed pattern Yochanan (John)'s-disciples enact at v.12's burial-and-going-to-tell-Yahusha (Jesus)). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Eliyahu-pattern architecture the Tanakh established (1 Melakhim (Kings) 17-22; 2 Melakhim (Kings) 1-2) and Malakhi (Malachi) 4:5-6 promised. The Achav-Yezevel-Torah-violation-architecture recapitulates at the Herod-Antipas / Herodias level; the Eliyahu-pattern prophet's-confrontation-of-the-unrighteous-ruler operates in continuity across the Tanakh, the wisdom-stream, and the gospel. The restoration-of-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov (Jacob) substance of Sirach 48:10 is the framework's scattered-seed-gathering-architecture the wisdom-stream knew at the Eliyahu-pattern register.

threads.title: The wilderness-manna and the bread-of-life as Word-of-Yahuah — Wisdom of Solomon 16, 2 Esdras 1, and Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24
threads.summary_md: Matt 14:13-21's feeding-of-the-five-thousand at the Galilee-desert-place — *and Yahusha (Jesus) went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick ... took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude. And they did all eat, and were filled* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wilderness-manna and the bread-from-heaven-as-Word-of-Yahuah architecture. Four moves: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:19 names the wilderness-manna in the prophetic-recap — *I gave you angels' food to eat in your hunger* (the Father's-wilderness-feeding-of-the-multitude substance); Wisdom of Solomon 16:20 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *thou feddest thine own people with angels' food, and didst send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight*; Wisdom of Solomon 16:26 names the bread-of-life-is-the-Word substance — *it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but that it is thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee*; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:19 names the wisdom-feeding-her-children invitation — *come unto me, all ye that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father's-wilderness-feeding architecture (Shemot (Exodus) 16) AND the bread-as-Word substance the Yochanan (John) 6 bread-of-life discourse explicitly anchors (John 6:32-35, 6:48-51, 6:63). The King at Matt 14:13-21 recapitulates the wilderness-manna without mediation (vs Mosheh (Moses)-mediated at Shemot 16) and exceeds Elisha's-feeding-of-the-hundred (2 Melakhim (Kings) 4:42-44) at the Galilee-desert-place; the twelve-baskets-leftover signal the twelve-tribes-restoration-architecture; the substance points beyond-the-loaves to the Word-of-the-King the disciples are being trained to receive as the bread-from-heaven the wisdom-stream had named the Father-feeding-his-people-with. The wisdom-stream knew the architecture at multiple registers; the King names the operative-form at the gospel-pivot.

threads.title: Wonders of the sea and the Creator's mastery — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 43 and Wisdom of Solomon 14
threads.summary_md: Matt 14:25's King-walking-on-the-sea in the fourth-watch — *and in the fourth watch of the night Yahusha (Jesus) went unto them, walking on the sea* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Creator's-mastery-of-the-deep architecture. Three moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 43:23 names *by his counsel he appeaseth the deep, and planteth islands therein* (the Creator's-counsel-appeasing-the-deep); Sirach 43:25 names *for in it be strange and wondrous works, variety of all kinds of beasts and whales created* (the wonders-of-the-sea as the Creator's-domain); Wisdom of Solomon 14:3 names *but thy providence, O Father, governeth it: for thou hast made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the Tanakh's-direct-Yahuah-substance the King's walking-on-the-sea enacts (Iyov (Job) 9:8 — *which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea*; Tehillim (Psalm) 77:19 — *thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters*; Habakkuk 3:15 — *thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters*). The framework's nature-of-God reading carries — the One who walks-upon-the-waves at Iyov (Job) 9:8 is the same One walking on the Galilee-sea in the fourth-watch; the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Creator's-mastery-of-the-deep (Sirach 43:23) + the Father's-providence-making-a-way-in-the-sea (Wisdom 14:3) names the substance behind-the-action; the King's walking-on-the-sea + the *it is I* / *egō eimi* self-identification at v.27 enacts the operative-form. The Formed-cloud-rider acts in the substance the Formless-Father's-counsel established and the Father's-providence-governs.

threads.title: The Ehyeh self-identification and the all-powerful Word leaping down from heaven — Wisdom of Solomon 18, Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24, and Wisdom of Solomon 9 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 14:27's *be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid* (Greek *egō eimi*) at the walking-on-the-sea moment — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the all-powerful-Word-leaping-down-from-heaven and the Wisdom-proceeding-from-the-mouth-of-the-most-High architecture. Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 18:15 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *thine almighty word leaped down from heaven out of thy royal throne, as a fierce man of war into the midst of a land of destruction* (the all-powerful-Word from-the-Father's-throne-coming-down-from-heaven); Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:3 names *I came out of the mouth of the most High, and covered the earth as a cloud* (the Wisdom-proceeding-from-the-mouth-of-the-Formless-most-High with the cloud-covering-the-earth-substance); Wisdom of Solomon 9:1 names *O Elohim (God) of my fathers, and Yahuah (Lord) of mercy, who hast made all things with thy word* (the Word-as-the-Father's-agent-of-creation). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the framework's Formless-Formed nature-of-God reading. The Greek *egō eimi* is the LXX-equivalent of the Tanakh's-Ehyeh (Shemot (Exodus) 3:14 — *Ehyeh asher Ehyeh* — *I AM THAT I AM*). The King's *it is I* at v.27 is the Ehyeh-substance self-naming at the moment of walking-on-the-sea. The framework rules out the Jehovah's-Witness-style flattening of *egō eimi* into mere-grammatical-self-reference without the divine-name-resonance. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the Formed-Word the Formless-Father expressed-from-the-beginning AND of the Word-as-agent-of-creation AND of the Wisdom-proceeding-from-the-mouth-of-the-most-High; the Yochanan (John) 1:14 *the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us* names the substance-in-person; the King's *it is I* across the dark water at the fourth-watch is the operative-form of the Word-from-heaven the wisdom-stream had named. The Formed-Word that proceeded from the Formless-Father in the Wisdom 18:15 + Sirach 24:3 + Wisdom 9:1 architecture is the speaker walking-on-the-water and naming-himself with the Ehyeh-substance. The framework reads this in continuity with the broader Yochanan (John) *egō eimi* sayings chain (John 6:35, 8:12, 10:7, 10:11, 11:25, 14:6, 15:1, and the load-bearing John 8:58's *before Avraham (Abraham) was, I am*).

threads.title: The righteous witness lied in wait for and condemned with a shameful death — Wisdom of Solomon 2:10-20
threads.summary_md: Matt 14:3-12's Herod-Antipas / Herodias / Salome arrangement that produces Yochanan (John) the Witness's beheading — *Herod had laid hold on Yochanan (John), and bound him ... For Yochanan (John) said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her ... when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude ... she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here Yochanan (John) the Immerser's head in a charger ... And he sent, and beheaded Yochanan (John) in the prison* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the ungodly-determining-to-lie-in-wait-for-the-righteous-and-condemn-him-with-a-shameful-death architecture. Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:12 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law*; Wisdom of Solomon 2:19 names the disposition's testing-pattern — *let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience*; Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 names the disposition's end-point — *let us condemn him with a shameful death.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's prophetic-naming of the disposition the Herod-Antipas / Herodias / Salome arrangement enacts at vv.3-12. Yochanan (John) upbraided Herod with the Torah-violation (Vayikra (Leviticus) 18:16, 20:21); the ungodly determined to-lie-in-wait-for-the-righteous; the birthday-banquet-oath arrangement removed the political-restraint Herod's-fear-of-the-multitude operated within; the shameful-death of the beheading-in-the-prison was the disposition's end-point. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture centuries before; Matt 14:3-12 names the operative-form at the Herod-court-level. The framework reads the disposition in continuity with its other Tanakh-and-NT manifestations: the Pharisaic-plot at Matt 12:14, the Sanhedrin's-arrangement of the King's-trial at Matt 26:3-4, the broader Tanakh-prophet-killing pattern at 2 Chronicles 24:20-22 and Matt 23:34-37. One architecture; multiple costumes; the wisdom-stream named it.

threads.title: The honor of parents — the fifth-commandment substance the Pharisaic Corban-tradition voids — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3 and 7, and Tobit 4
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:3-6's Pharisaic-Corban-tradition exposé — *Why do ye also transgress the commandment of Elohim (God) by your tradition? For Elohim (God) commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother ... But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of Elohim (God) of none effect by your tradition* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the fifth-commandment substance the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition voids. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:1 names *hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter, that you may be safe* (the wisdom-stream's headline articulation of the parental-honor architecture as the foundation-of-the-children's-safety); Sirach 3:8 names the holistic-honor — *honour your father and mother both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon you from them* (the architecture the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition split, allowing word-without-deed); Sirach 7:27 names the whole-heart-honor — *honour your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother* (the heart-level architecture the King will close the loop on at vv.18-20); Sirach 3:16 names the worst-end — *he that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed: of Yahuah (God)* (the disposition of the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition at its most-honest naming — blasphemy and curse); Tobit 4:3 names the deathbed-instruction — *my son, when I am dead, bury me; and despise not your mother, but honour her all the days of your life* (the second-Temple Yashar'el (Israel)-household's articulation of the all-the-days-of-her-life parental-honor extension). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the Torah-substance the King defends against the Pharisaic-Corban-tradition. The Pharisaic-system had built the Corban-vow-mechanism to override the parental-honor commandment while preserving its righteousness-credentialing; the wisdom-stream had named the substance the tradition was voiding centuries before. The King's-charge at vv.3-6 lands at the same load-bearing diagnostic the wisdom-stream had named: the disposition that voids the parental-honor commandment is at the architecture of blasphemy-against-the-Torah-the-Father-spoke-from-Sinai.

threads.title: The heart the source of evil — not the Father — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 15 and 27, and Wisdom of Solomon 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:10-20's heart-defilement-versus-mouth-defilement teaching — *not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man ... those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man. For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the heart-as-the-source-of-evil-and-the-Father-NOT-being-the-source substance.
