Four moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 15:11 names the Father-NOT-the-source — *say not you, It is through Yahuah (God) that I fell away: for you oughtest not to do the things that he hates*; Sirach 15:20 names the corollary — *he has commanded no man to do wickedly, neither has he given any man licence to sin* (the substance the King's-articulation at Matt 15:18-19 lands the operative-form for); Sirach 27:6 names the tree-and-fruit-and-utterance architecture — *the fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man* (the heart's-substance manifests in the mouth's-utterance, the same architecture the King's Matt 7:17-20 and Matt 15:18 walk); Wisdom of Solomon 1:11 names the mouth-substance overlap with the King's-Matt-15:19-catalogue — *beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting ... the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the heart-and-mouth-substance-as-the-locus-of-defilement architecture the King restores at vv.10-20. The Torah's clean-and-unclean architecture of Vayikra (Leviticus) 11 is NOT abolished (Acts 10:14's direct evidence — Kefa (Peter) had never eaten anything common or unclean post-resurrection); the rabbinic-fence-tradition that had located-defilement at the un-washed-hands-and-the-food-categorically-touched-by-them IS dismantled; the heart-Torah of Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33 / Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 is restored. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King names the operative-form at the gospel-precision.

threads.title: The gathering of the scattered twelve tribes — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36, 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13, and Tobit 13 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:24's *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the King's-own-mission-scope statement, paired with the Matt 10:5-6's apostolic-mission-scope, reading as the load-bearing scripture-anchor for the framework's gathering-of-the-scattered-twelve-tribes thesis — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gathering-of-the-scattered-tribes prayer-and-prophecy substance. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:1 names the petition — *have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us* (the wisdom-stream's-prayer-for-the-gathering); Sirach 36:11 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the twelve-tribes-restoration the prophets had named at Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:21; Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:8-10; Hosea 1:10-11; Zekharyah (Zechariah) 10:6-10); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:40 names the ten-tribes-carried-away — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive* (the wisdom-stream's-direct-articulation of the Assyrian-exile-architecture the lost-sheep-mission-scope addresses); 2 Esdras 13:48 names the remnant-within-the-borders — *but those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders* (the wisdom-stream's naming of both registers the King's-mission addresses); Tobit 13:5 names the scourge-then-mercy-then-gathering-out-of-all-nations — *he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* (the operative-architecture the King's-mission enacts). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the lost-sheep-mission-scope's wisdom-stream corroboration. The Pharisaic-system had built credentialing-systems on top of the binary (Yahudah (Judah) and the nations, no scattered-twelve-tribes coming-home); the wisdom-stream had preserved the architecture the prophets had named. The King's-mission at v.24 IS the operative-form of the wisdom-stream's-prayer at Sirach 36:11; the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the King is sent-to IS the all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov (Jacob) the wisdom-stream had prayed for the gathering of. The framework reads the Canaanite-woman's mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance (vv.25-28) within the architecture — as the master's-table-mercy-to-the-categorical-nations-individual that does NOT collapse the seed-distinction (Red Line #7) but operates within it.

threads.title: The seed of promise specifically to Yashar'el (Israel) — not to the other seed of Avraham (Abraham) — Jubilees 15 and 16 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:22-28's Canaanite-woman pericope — the King's-children-vs-dogs distinction at v.26 (*it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs*) and the woman's-acceptance-of-the-architecture at v.27 (*Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the seed-of-promise-specifically-to-Yashar'el (Israel)-NOT-to-other-seed-of-Avraham (Abraham) substance. Four moves: Jubilees 15:30 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *for Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people* (the wisdom-stream's precise articulation of the seed-distinction the Pharisaic-system's-binary erased and the modern-Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse erases); Jubilees 15:31 names the spiritual-jurisdictional architecture — *for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him* (the *bene Elohim* allocation per Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8-9's Septuagint and Dead Sea Scrolls reading); Jubilees 15:32 names the Yashar'el (Israel)-under-direct-rule architecture — *but over Yashar'el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler* (the architecture the King's-mission-to-the-lost-sheep at v.24 enacts under the Father's-direct-shepherding); Jubilees 16:17 names the holy-seed-from-the-sons-of-Yitschaq (Isaac) — *and (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of Yahuah (God) most High* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the holy-seed-from-Yitschaq (Isaac)-NOT-reckoned-among-the-nations architecture). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #7 seed-distinction's wisdom-stream corroboration. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture with explicit-precision centuries before the Pharisaic-binary and the modern-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse arose. The Canaanite-woman is outside the seed-architecture the wisdom-stream had named; the King's-distinction at v.26 operates exactly in the architecture; the woman's-acceptance-at-v.27 honors the architecture; the King's-mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance at v.28 grants-within-the-architecture without collapsing it. The framework reads this in continuity with Romans 9:6-13's *they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel) ... in Yitschaq (Isaac) shall thy seed be called* — Paul's articulation of the same wisdom-stream substance the inherited-Christian reading flattens-to-the-replacement-theology-of-the-church-replacing-Yashar'el (Israel) or the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's self-selection-by-belief-and-practice.

threads.title: The Yovel cycle and the year-weeks architecture — Jubilees 50
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:32-39's feeding-of-the-four-thousand with seven-loaves-and-seven-baskets-remaining — paired with the twelve-baskets-of-the-feeding-of-the-five-thousand at Matt 14:20 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Yovel-cycle and year-weeks architecture Jubilees structures the entire-Tanakh-chronology around. Three moves: Jubilees 50:1 names the Sabbath-architecture-revealed-in-the-desert-of-Sinai (*after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai*); Jubilees 50:2 names the jubilee-years-in-the-sabbaths-of-years (*I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years* — the seven-times-seven-years-equals-forty-nine-then-the-fiftieth-year-jubilee substance of Vayikra (Leviticus) 25:8-10); Jubilees 50:4 names the forty-nine-jubilees-from-Adam-until-this-day chronological-architecture (*I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Yovel-substance the seven-baskets-of-the-second-feeding signal at the chapter's-closing-scene. The seven-architecture of the second-feeding signals the Yovel-completion-substance the Jubilees-wisdom-stream had structured the entire-Tanakh-chronology around. The King's-pedagogical-double-feeding (twelve-baskets at Matt 14:20 for the twelve-tribes-gathering; seven-baskets at Matt 15:37 for the Yovel-completion) encodes the architecture's-completion-arc the wisdom-stream had named the chronological-substance for. The framework reads this in continuity with Luke 4:18-21's Natsareth (Nazareth)-synagogue-reading of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 61:1-2's *acceptable year of Yahuah (the LORD)* — the King's-naming-himself as the One the Yovel-substance-proclaims at the gospel-fulfillment.

threads.title: The Son of the living Elohim named before the foundation — 1 Enoch 46 and 48, and Wisdom of Solomon 2, beside Matthew 16:13-17
threads.summary_md: *When Yahusha (Jesus) came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (Matthew 16:13). He asks it with the title already in his mouth. Peter answers, *And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).* (Matthew 16:16), and is told where the answer came from: *And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 16:17). Enoch had asked the same question of the angel who walked with him: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2), and got the same kind of answer, from heaven: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). And he was told how old the name is: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days. Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:2-3). The Wisdom of Solomon had the wicked say of the just man that if he is the son of Elohim (God), he will help him and deliver him out of their hands, and they would prove it by his death, which is exactly what the chief priests said under the cross. Peter did not work the confession out by watching miracles. The Father showed him what had been true since before the stars, and Peter said it. That is how it always goes: the sheep hear because they are sheep, and the Father reveals what he settled before the foundation of the world.

threads.title: The Elect One on the throne and the keys of the kingdom — 1 Enoch 49, 51, 62 and 69 beside Matthew 16:19
threads.summary_md: *And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.* (Matthew 16:19). A steward can only hand out keys that belong to the house he serves, so the question behind the verse is whose house it is and who holds the judgement the keys administer. Enoch answers from the throne room. The Elect One stands before the Father and is given the secrets: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:2). He sits on the Father's throne and what he pours out is wisdom, not his own invention: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). He was kept hidden and then shown to the elect: *For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.* (1 Enoch 62:7). And the whole of judgement is put into his hands: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). John heard the same from his own mouth: *For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:* (John 5:22), *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.* (John 5:27). That is the throne the keys come down from. Isaiah had shown the pattern already in Shebna and Eliakim, the self-appointed steward put out of the house and the key of David laid on the shoulder of the one the Master chose. The scribes and priests of the second temple were Shebna; the twelve were Eliakim; and what Peter received was a stewardship under the Son's judgement, binding and loosing what the Master of the house had already bound and loosed. Any church that reads the verse as a licence to define doctrine against the Word of the house has mistaken the steward for the owner.

threads.title: The righteous one condemned with a shameful death — Wisdom of Solomon 2, 3, and 5
threads.summary_md: Matt 16:21's first-explicit-passion-prediction — *he must go unto Yerushalayim (Jerusalem), and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the righteous-one persecuted-and-condemned-with-a-shameful-death and vindicated-in-the-resurrection substance. Five moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:12 names the wicked's-plot-against-the-righteous-one (*let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings*); Wisdom of Solomon 2:16 names the wicked's-grievance against the righteous-one's-credentialing (*we are esteemed of him as counterfeits ... he maketh his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father*); Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the shameful-death (*let us condemn him with a shameful death*); Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 names the souls-of-the-righteous-preserved-in-the-Father's-hand substance (*the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them*); Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 names the righteous-man's-vindication-before-the-face-of-the-wicked substance (*then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct prefiguring of the operative-substance the King's-first-passion-prediction at Matt 16:21 names: the elders-and-chief-priests-and-scribes (the Pharisaic-and-Sadducean-second-Temple-aristocracy) are the wicked-Wisdom-of-Solomon-2 names; the King is the righteous-one-Wisdom-of-Solomon-2-prefigures; the suffering-and-killing the King names is the operative-fulfillment of the shameful-death the wisdom-stream had named; the third-day-raising is the operative-fulfillment of the vindication-of-the-righteous the wisdom-stream had named at Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 and 5:1. The framework reads the substance in continuity with the Tanakh-suffering-servant of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53 + the Devarim (Deuteronomy) 21:23 *cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree* the apostolic-stream-articulation at Galatians 3:13 lands; the wisdom-stream-prefiguring at Wisdom of Solomon 2-5 + the Tanakh-suffering-servant + the gospel-passion-prediction + the apostolic-stream-articulation cohere at the shameful-death-and-vindication architecture the King's-own-passion-prediction names at v.21.

threads.title: The gates of Sheol and the dead given back — Wisdom of Solomon, 1 Enoch 51 and 2 Esdras 4 beside Matthew 16:18
threads.summary_md: *And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.* (Matthew 16:18). The gates of hell are the gates of Sheol, the grave, the place where the dead are held. The pulpit turned the phrase into the mouth of an everlasting furnace, but the library that Yahusha (Jesus) grew up in uses it for the power of death that came in with the curse. The Wisdom of Solomon says that Elohim (God) made not death, and has no pleasure in the destruction of the living, and that he has power of life and death, leads down to the gates of hell and brings up again. Hosea had the Father say it in his own voice: *I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.* (Hosea 13:14). And Enoch was shown the day the gates give way: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). Ezra heard the righteous waiting for that day in their chambers: *Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?* (2 Esdras 4:35). So the promise to the assembly is a resurrection promise. The grave will take its members the way it takes everyone, and it will not be allowed to keep them, because the one who builds the assembly is the one who walked out of the tomb on the third day and holds the keys: *I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.* (Revelation 1:18). The assembly shares in his rising at the first resurrection, and Sheol gives back what it owes.

threads.title: Reward according to works — the post-harvest sifting — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 16 and 35, and 2 Esdras 7
threads.summary_md: Matt 16:27's *the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the rewarding-according-to-works at the day-of-judgment substance. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 16:12 names the wisdom-stream's headline-articulation (*as his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works*); Sirach 16:14 names the universal-substance (*every man shall find according to his works*); Sirach 35:19 names the rendering-to-every-man-according-to-his-deeds paired with the judging-of-the-cause-of-the-Father's-people (*till he have rendered to every man according to his deeds ... till he have judged the cause of his people*); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:32 names the resurrection-of-the-dead-preceding-the-day-of-judgment substance (*the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence*); 2 Esdras 7:35 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the work-shall-follow-and-the-reward-shall-be-shewed substance (*the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 the King's-Son-of-Adam-coming-and-rewarding substance at v.27 articulates at the gospel-pivot. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the rewarding-according-to-works at the day-of-judgment; the King names the operative-form at the Son-of-Adam's-coming; the framework reads the substance in continuity with the framework's-grace-and-the-opportunity-that-can-be-lost architecture — the grace is the door-home; the works are the fruit-of-the-new-heart-that-internalized-or-did-not-internalize per the Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 substance; the reward at the day-of-judgment operates according-to-the-fruit, in the post-harvest-sifting Matt 7:21-23 + Matt 13:36-43 + Matt 25:31-46 articulate at the gospel-substance the wisdom-stream had named. The Tehillim (Psalm) 62:12 *thou renderest to every man according to his work* substance Romans 2:6 cites carries the same architecture across the canon and into the apostolic-stream.

threads.title: Effort over accomplishment — the same God says both
threads.summary_md:
The Reformation reader has been shaped to believe two thoughts cannot stand in the same paragraph. The same God who said *not for your righteousness do I do this, but for my own name's sake* — also said *depart from me, ye that work iniquity, I never knew you.* The same God who said *for by grace are ye saved through faith* — also said *whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.* The same God who said *I will give you a new heart* — also said *ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities.*

The Reformation kept the *for my name's sake* half and put a period where there should have been a colon. The rabbinic system kept the *depart from me* half and built a flesh-righteousness gospel. The framework holds both halves because scripture holds both halves. The place where they hold together is the phrase that names the diagnostic: **effort over accomplishment.**

*"For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief."* (Proverbs 24:16)

The just is not the man who never fell. The wicked is not the man who failed to accomplish. What separates them is not the verdict — *none worthy* has already fallen on every flesh — but the heart's response. The just rises. The wicked *stops his ears* (Proverbs 28:9; Zechariah 7:11-12; Acts 7:57). Open ears and a returning heart, even after seven falls, is the sign of life; stopped ears, even after a hundred sermons, is the sign of death.

The new heart's signature response to grace is not the boast. It is the hanging head — *ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities* (Ezekiel 36:31; 20:43; Job 42:5-6; Isaiah 6:5; Daniel 9:5). The Reformation gospel produces a head that holds itself up because it is *saved.* The rabbinic gospel produces a head that holds itself up because it is *righteous.* The framework's new heart produces a head that goes lower the more it sees His mercy.

*"Remember the former things of old: for I am El, and there is none else; I am Elohim (God), and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure."* (Isaiah 46:9-10)

The whole architecture is sealed by the end the Father declared from the beginning. The end is the gathering — the twelve tribes home, the new heart given, the kingdom of priests, the Way restored. Every system that denies the gathering denies the end; every system that denies the end calls Him a liar; to call Him a liar is to reject the mercy that hangs on His name. The architecture stands or falls as one piece.

Companion threads: `grace-from-names-sake` carries the name's-sake-mercy pillar; `new-heart` carries the Torah-internalized pillar; `post-harvest-sifting` carries the wheat-sifting pillar; `grace-and-the-opportunity-that-can-be-lost` carries the standing-can-be-forfeit warning at the Matt 6 anchor. This thread anchors the architecture at the Proverbs 24:16 hinge and adds the stopped-ears discriminator, the hanging-heads sign, and the end-declared seal.

threads.title: The Watchers' rebellion and the first stumbling-blocks — 1 Enoch 8, 10, 19, 22 and 27 beside Matthew 18:6-9
threads.summary_md: *But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea. Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!* (Matthew 18:6-7). The word is a stumbling-block, something laid in the road to trip a walker, and Yahusha (Jesus) says they are bound to come. Enoch tells where the first ones were laid. *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1). Weapons for the hand and paint for the eye, taught by a fallen angel, and the whole world tripped over them: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.'* (1 Enoch 10:8). The spirits that came out of that rebellion are still laying stones in the road: *And Uriel said to me: 'Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). Many different forms. Every system that teaches men against the commandments of their Maker, in whatever robe, is one of those forms, and the woe lands on the men who run it, not on the little ones tripped by it. The judgement that makes the millstone look like mercy is the one Enoch saw: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). And the valley Yahusha names, Gehenna, the valley of Hinnom on the south side of Jerusalem, Enoch had already been shown in the middle of the holy mountain: *Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: 'This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* (1 Enoch 27:2). That is what the hell fire of Matthew 18:9 is, the accursed valley of judgement the prophets and Enoch knew, and not the endless furnace the pulpit read back into the word. Better to lose a hand than to walk into that valley with both.

threads.title: The Lord of the sheep and the gathering — 1 Enoch 40 and 89-90 beside Matthew 18:10-14
threads.summary_md: *Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven. For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.* (Matthew 18:10-11). Then comes the shepherd who leaves the ninety and nine on the mountains to go after the one that strayed, and the Father's will that not one of these little ones should perish. Enoch saw the angels who stand before that face. *And he said to me: 'This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.'* (1 Enoch 40:9). And in the dream of the sheep he saw the Shepherd himself, called by the name Yahuah. When the wolves of Egypt oppressed the flock, the sheep cried to their Lord, and he came down for them: *And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.* (1 Enoch 89:16). The same Lord raises up a shepherd when the beasts devour the flock, *And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.* (1 Enoch 89:42), and when the sheep forsake his house and are given over, Enoch watches until the day the eyes of the lambs come open: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* (1 Enoch 90:6). At the end the Lord of the sheep acts for them with his own hand: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). This is Ezekiel 34 in a dream, the Father against the shepherds who fed themselves and the one Shepherd who comes to seek the lost. The parable in Matthew works at both levels at once: the little one in the assembly who must not be despised, and the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) he said he was sent to. Both belong to the same Lord of the sheep, and the lambs whose eyes open are the ones who hear his voice when he calls, because they are his.

threads.title: The reproof-and-restoration procedure — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 19-20's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 18:15-17's four-step assembly-discipline pattern
threads.summary_md: Matt 18:15-17's four-step assembly-discipline procedure — *go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone* → *take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established* → *tell it unto the assembly* → *let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the reproof-and-restoration procedure in Sirach (Ecclesiasticus). Four moves: Sirach 19:13 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the first-step private-confrontation substance (*admonish a friend, it may be he has not done it: and if he have done it, that he may do it no more*) — the wisdom-stream had named the substance the King institutionalizes; Sirach 19:17 names the disposition-the-rebuker-walks-in (*admonish your neighbour before you threaten him; and not being angry, give place to the law of the Most High*) — the order and the inner-substance; Sirach 19:15 names the substance the witness-verification-procedure protects against (*for many times it is a slander, and believe not every tale*) — the architecture the King's two-or-three-witnesses applies the Tanakh-Devarim (Deuteronomy) 19:15 evidentiary-standard for; Sirach 20:2 names the substance of the open-reproof (*it is much better to reprove, than to be angry secretly: and he that confesseth his fault shall be preserved from hurt*) — the architecture under the King's step-three assembly-level confrontation. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct-prefiguring of the King's assembly-discipline pattern at the procedural-register the King will institutionalize. The substance is restoration-aimed at every step — *if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother* (v.15) is the desired-outcome of the wisdom-stream's instruction; the framework reads this in continuity with Vayikra (Leviticus) 19:17's *thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour* Tanakh-anchor and Galatians 6:1's apostolic-restatement *restore such an one in the spirit of meekness.* The framework rules out the institutional-Christian-collapse of step-four into permanent-shunning-and-condemnation — the substance is disposition-shift from internal-assembly-member to mission-target per the patience-not-condescension posture, NOT condemnation-to-permanent-exclusion.

threads.title: Forgive and be forgiven — the mercy-met-with-mercy architecture in Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 27-28 and Testament of Gad read against Matt 18:21-35's seventy-times-seven + unforgiving-servant parable + heart-Torah closing (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 18:21-35's unified forgiveness-arc — Kefa (Peter)'s *till seven times?* question + the King's *seventy times seven* answer inverting Lamekh (Lamech)'s *if Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamekh (Lamech) seventy and sevenfold* at Bereshit (Genesis) 4:24 + the unforgiving-servant parable + the chapter-closing *so likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not* — read against the wisdom-stream's most-direct prefiguring in Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 27-28 and Testament of Gad. Five moves: Sirach 27:30 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the disposition-the-King-is-forming-against — *malice and wrath, even these are abominations* — the substance Kefa's *how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?* is still operating within; Sirach 28:2 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the conditional-forgiveness-architecture — *forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest* — the same conditional-substance the King's parable extends into full narrative-form and the chapter-closing v.35 *if ye from your hearts forgive not* locks; Sirach 28:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the unforgiving-servant's-grotesque-architecture — *one man bears hatred against another, and does he seek pardon from Yahuah (God)?* — the architecture the King's lord-of-the-parable names at v.33 (*shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?*); Sirach 28:7 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the heart-Torah-substance — *remember the commandments, and bear no malice to your neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance* — the Torah-internalized-and-the-substance-of-no-malice as one-substance-not-two; Testament of Gad 62:3 names the wisdom-stream's heart-substance + speak-peaceably-to-the-sinning-brother substance (*love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him*) the King's assembly-arc operationalizes at vv.15-17 AND v.35. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR: the wisdom-stream had named the architecture of mercy-met-with-mercy at the wisdom-instruction-register; the King institutionalizes the same architecture at the kingdom-citizens' corporate-register and parable-extends it into full-narrative-form. The framework rules out the institutional-Christian-once-saved-always-saved doctrine — the lord-revokes the forgiveness when the disposition-the-forgiveness-was-given-to-form does not form; the cross opens the door home, the door remains real (1 Corinthians 9:27's *lest by any means... I myself should be a castaway*). The framework reads this in continuity with Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33's new-covenant law-in-the-inward-parts and Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's new-heart-and-Spirit-causing-the-walking — the wisdom-stream's substance the King brings to-completion at the cross-and-the-Spirit-and-the-walking the assembly is-being-formed-into.

threads.title: Greatness as humility and the proud cast down — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3 and 10's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 18:1-5's greatness-as-child kingdom-inversion
threads.summary_md: Matt 18:1-5's opening movement — the disciples' v.1 hierarchy-question (*who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?*) + the King's-acted-parable of a little child set in the midst + the *except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven* substance + the *whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven* inversion + the *whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me* extension — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the kingdom-inversion-of-greatness substance. Three moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 10:7 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the disposition-the-King-is-confronting at the disciples' v.1 hierarchy-question — *pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man: and by both does one commit iniquity*; Sirach 3:18 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the kingdom-inversion-of-greatness substance — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God)* — the wisdom-stream had named the substance the King teaches at the assembly-disposition register; Sirach 10:14 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the kingdom-inversion-of-thrones substance — *Yahuah (God) has cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead* — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the same inversion the King names at v.4, with the eschatological-day-of-the-Father pre-figuring at Mary's Magnificat (Luke 1:51-52's *he hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree*) and the apostolic-restatement at 1 Corinthians 1:26-29 (*Elohim (God) hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise*). The framework reads the cluster in continuity with the Tanakh-*anawim* (humble-poor) substance pattern (Tehillim (Psalm) 131:1-2's weaned-child; Tehillim (Psalm) 8:2's out-of-the-mouth-of-babes; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:6's little-child-shall-lead-them; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 57:15's contrite-and-humble-spirit; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:2's poor-and-of-a-contrite-spirit; Mishlei (Proverbs) 22:4's humility-and-the-fear-of-Yahuah). The apostolic-restatement at 1 Peter 5:5 (citing Mishlei (Proverbs) 3:34) and Yaaqov (James) 4:10 lands the substance at the apostolic-kingdom-citizens' disposition-register. The kingdom-citizen's-greatness is measured by the depth of the humility-substance, not by the height of the position-substance. The framework rules out the institutional-Christian-individualistic-power-grasping inversion-fail and the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion universalization-of-the-child-substance into a generic-everyone-can-be-saved substance.

threads.title: Creation-ordinance marriage and the blessed eunuch — Jubilees 3 + Tobit 8 + Wisdom of Solomon 3 on Matt 19:3-12

threads.title: Woes on the rich and riches cannot save — 1 Enoch 94-100 beside Matthew 19:23-26
threads.summary_md: *Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven. And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).* (Matthew 19:23-24). The disciples are staggered, *Who then can be saved?*, because they had been taught that wealth was the sign of the Father's favor, and he answers, *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible.* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch's last chapters are a long string of woes against the very trust the young ruler had just walked away with. *Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). He puts the rich man's own words in his mouth: *Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say: 'We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And have acquired everything we have desired. And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.' And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:8-9), which is the rich fool of Luke 12 word for word, *And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.* (Luke 12:18). And he says why the money cannot help on the day it matters: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.* (1 Enoch 98:10); *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). The Psalm had said it before Enoch's book was read in Galilee: *None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:* (Psalm 49:7). There was no little gate in Jerusalem called the Needle's Eye; the saying means what it says. And it does not turn Abraham's flocks or the blessings of Deuteronomy 28 into a curse; those came to men whose heart was with Yahuah (God). It is the trust that damns, and the only ransom that counts is the one the Son of Adam came to pay.

The historic-redemptive substance the parable carries — early-hired prefiguring Yahudah (Judah) the southern-house-that-retained-the-tribal-identity, eleventh-hour-laborers prefiguring the scattered-seed-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the ten-northern-tribes now-being-gathered-home through-the-King's-proclamation, the same-penny-of-inheritance ruling-out the murmuring-against-the-late-coming-of-the-scattered-seed-from-any-quarter — coheres at Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant architecture and at the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* completion-of-the-sentence the Reformation cut-in-half.

threads.title: Many be called, but few chosen — 1 Enoch 48 and 2 Esdras 8 on the broad call and the few
threads.summary_md: The parable of the laborers closes on a hard line: *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.* (Matthew 20:16). The call goes out broadly because the sheep are scattered everywhere and no one can tell them by sight, and the chosen are the ones who were his before the call ever reached them. He says it himself in John 10: *ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep ... my sheep hear my voice.* The hearing does not make a sheep; it shows one. Enoch saw the broad call as a fountain anyone could come to: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* (1 Enoch 48:1). And he saw who the Son of Adam was kept for: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). Ezra was told the same count in plainer arithmetic: *there be many created, but few shall be saved* (2 Esdras 8:3). The many are not cheated; the call really went out to them. The few are the ones written from the foundation of the world (Revelation 13:8), who heard because they were his, and who then walked in it, because the warning about being blotted out is spoken to the wheat and never to the tares. The last made first are the scattered ones nobody expected, and the first made last are the ones who stood in the field all day and never bore the fruit.

threads.title: The Son of Adam came to give his life a ransom for many — the Parables of Enoch, the Testament of Benjamin and Sirach beside Matthew 20:28
threads.summary_md: *Even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* (Matthew 20:28). The sons of Zebedee had asked for the seats on his right and his left, and he answers by turning the whole order of greatness upside down: whoever would be great must serve, and he says it of himself first. The title he uses makes the saying heavier than it sounds. The Son of Adam is the one Enoch saw beside the Head of Days: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3), named before anything was made: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). The ransom was settled that early too; John calls him the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. And the one who gives his life is the one the kings will one day beg mercy of: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). The same figure who serves at the first coming judges at the second. The ransom is the Torah's own word, the price paid for a life, and the *many* are Isaiah's many: *He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.* (Isaiah 53:11); *Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.* (Isaiah 53:12). Not everyone without distinction, and not a handful picked at random, but the many whose names the Father wrote. The Testament of Benjamin had said the Most High would be lowly on earth and glorious in heaven, and Sirach that the greater a man is the more he must humble himself. The King took the lowest place in the room on purpose, because that is where the ransom gets paid.

Three moves: Testaments of the Twelve 37:5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the star-from-Ya'aqov (Jacob) substance — the same Davidic-Messianic credential Bamidbar (Numbers) 24:17's *there shall come a Star out of Ya'aqov (Jacob), and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* the prophet Bila'am (Balaam) carried; Testaments of the Twelve 38:4 names the Branch-of-Elohim-Most-High substance — the same righteous-Branch Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23:5-6 names (*I will raise unto David a righteous Branch ... this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS)*) and Zekharyah (Zechariah) 6:12 names (*behold the man whose name is The BRANCH*); Testaments of the Twelve 38:5 names the sceptre-of-the-kingdom-shining-forth + root-with-stem-arising substance — the Davidic-Messianic credential extended through the wisdom-stream's prefiguring at the same register as the prophet-witnesses. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream and pseudepigraphal-stream's direct corroboration of the Davidic-Messianic-substance the marginalized two-blind-men at Yericho (Jericho) walk-into-recognizing — the substance the Tanakh-prophetic-corpus had named (2 Samuel 7:12-16's Davidic-covenant; Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:1-2, 10's rod-of-Yishai (Jesse) and root-of-Yishai (Jesse); Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23:5-6's righteous-Branch; Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34:23-24 and 37:24-25's David-the-servant-king of the restored-twelve-tribes; Bamidbar (Numbers) 24:17's star-and-sceptre). The marginalized-substance the gospel has been preserving through the Matt 9:27-31 Galilean-two-blind-men, the Matt 15:22 Canaanite-woman, here-at-the-Yericho (Jericho)-two-blind-men, anticipates the Matt 21:9 triumphal-entry *Hoshanna (Hosanna) to the Son of David* and the Matt 22:41-46 King's-own-question-on-the-Son-of-David — the seed-war-hearing-pattern operates substantially through-the-gospel-account, recognizing-the-Davidic-Messianic-substance the surrounding-system-cannot-see.

threads.title: The Davidic-Messianic-King meek-on-the-foal at the entry — Testaments of the XII Patriarchs (Yahudah ch 15), 2 Maccabees 10:7's branches-and-palms-and-psalms, and Sirach 36:14's glory-filling-Tsion
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:1-11's triumphal-entry-substance — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) coming-to-his-city on the foal-of-an-ass per Zecharyah (Zechariah) 9:9; the multitudes crying *Hoshia-na (Hosanna) to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of Yahuah (the LORD)* from Tehillim (Psalm) 118:25-26's pilgrim-Hallel; the branches-and-garments strewn in the way; the city's *Who is this?* answered by the multitude's *the prophet of Natsareth (Nazareth) of Galil (Galilee)* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Davidic-Messianic-King substance the wisdom-stream-corpus had carried for centuries before the gospel-pivot. Four moves: Test. Yahudah (Judah) ch 15 v.5 (= testaments-xii ch 38 in the Charles vol 2 flat-chapter scheme) names THE direct verbal-anchor for the sceptre-of-the-kingdom-shining-forth + the stem-arising-from-the-root substance (*then shall the sceptre of my kingdom shine forth ; and from your root shall arise a stem*) — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Tanakh-Netser-Branch-substance per Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:1 the King-of-the-tribe-of-Yahudah (Judah) walks-out at the entry; Test. The framework reads the substance per Red Line #7 + Red Line #11 — the *all that call upon Yahuah (Lord)* in Test. Yahudah carries the wisdom-stream-convention of *Gentiles* as the scattered-seed-of-Yashar'el (Israel) living-as-Gentiles-among-the-nations per the apostolic-Paul-letters-convention, NOT the categorical-Three-Categories-#3-nations replacing-Yashar'el; the meekness-substance is the Greek *praus* / Hebrew *ani* substance per Matthew 5:5 and Matthew 11:29 the King-of-Yashar'el walks-against the natural-kingdoms'-substance-of-domination per Matthew 20:25.

threads.title: Temple-cleansing and the Maccabean-rededication architecture — 1 Maccabees 4, 2 Maccabees 10, and Sirach 35:12's do-not-corrupt-with-gifts
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:12-17's temple-cleansing-substance — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) overturning-the-tables-of-the-moneychangers in the Court-of-the-goyim (Gentiles); the King citing Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 56:7 *my house shall be called the house of prayer* (whose context names the outcasts-of-Yashar'el being-gathered-to-the-holy-mountain — the gathering of the scattered-seed-coming-home per Red Line #7) + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 7:11 *den of thieves* (whose context is one of the Tanakh's most-substantial Temple-judgment-passages, walking the same substance against the Second-Temple leadership the prophet had walked at the First-Temple); the healing of the blind-and-the-lame in the Temple reversing the rabbinic-substance reading of 2 Samuel 5:8 as a categorical-exclusion; the children-in-the-Temple crying *Hoshia-na (Hosanna) to the Son of David* with the King citing Tehillim (Psalm) 8:2 *out of the mouth of babes and sucklings* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Maccabean-Hanukkah-temple-cleansing architecture and the wisdom-stream's direct articulation against the substance of corrupt-gifts. Four moves: 1 Maccabees 4:43 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the cleansing-of-the-sanctuary substance (*who cleansed the sanctuary, and bare out the defiled stones into an unclean place*) — the architectural-substance the King-walks-out at the Second-Temple-pivot, with the architectural-parallel running at-two-different-pivots between the Maccabean-cleansing-against-the-Antiochene-outer-defilement and the King's-cleansing-against-the-Pharisaic-Sadducean-inner-corruption; 2 Maccabees 10:3 names the wisdom-stream's narration of the Hanukkah-cleansing-followed-by-the-restoration-of-the-sacrifice + the incense + the lights + the shewbread (*having cleansed the temple they made another altar*) — the substance the Father's-house was-meant-for; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 35:12 names THE direct verbal-anchor against the substance of the monetization-substance the King-overturns-the-tables-of (*do not think to corrupt with gifts; for such he will not receive: and trust not to unrighteous sacrifices; for Yahuah (God) is judge, and with him is no respect of persons*) — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation the King walks-out at the temple-cleansing-substance; 1 Maccabees 4:46 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the prophet-yet-to-come substance (*until there should come a prophet to shew what should be done with them*) — the wisdom-stream-substance had-laid the substance-of-anticipation for the prophet-to-come whom the multitude at v.11 names *the prophet of Natsareth (Nazareth) of Galil (Galilee)* and the King-walks-out at the temple-cleansing-substance carrying-the-substance-of-the-prophet-arrived. The framework reads the substance per the system-not-people-posture — the substance the King-walks-against is the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership-substance the wisdom-stream-Sirach-50-substance had-named the Simon-the-high-priest-substance the architectural-parallel-of; the substance is-NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically.

threads.title: Leaves without fruit — the fig tree, the unfruitful branches of Wisdom and Sirach, and the flock torn when its shepherds fall away
threads.summary_md: *And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.* (Matthew 21:19). The tree had the look of a tree in season and nothing under the leaves, and the King's hand on it was a prophet's act against a leadership that had the same look. The prophets had used the fig that way for a long time, Hosea and Jeremiah and Joel and Micah all going to the tree for fruit and finding none. The Wisdom of Solomon says what becomes of such a tree: *for though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out* (the Wisdom of Solomon 4:4), and *the imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing* (the Wisdom of Solomon 4:5). Sirach says the same of the line that has no root: *her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit* (Ecclesiasticus 23:25). The Animal Apocalypse shows what it costs the flock when the ones set over it forsake the house: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place. And He gave them over into the hands of the lions and tigers, and wolves and hyenas, and into the hand of the foxes, and to all the wild beasts, and those wild beasts began to tear in pieces those sheep.* (1 Enoch 89:54-55). The curse on the tree is not a curse on Yashar'el (Israel). It falls on the leaders with leaves and no fruit, the same men the woes of Matthew 23 are spoken to, the shepherds Ezekiel 34 and Jeremiah 23 said fed themselves and scattered the sheep. Leaves without fruit leave a flock without a shepherd, and the good shepherd came for the flock those shepherds scattered.

threads.title: Parable of the two sons and the wisdom-stream's repentance-and-hypocrisy architecture — Sirach 17:24, Sirach 1:28-29, Sirach 21:1, and 2 Esdras 9:11
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:28-32's parable-of-the-two-sons-substance — the doing-of-the-Father's-will substance against the saying-yes-without-doing substance; the first-son-substance saying *I will not* (Greek *ou thelō*) and-afterward-repenting-and-going (the publicans-and-harlots walking the substance the Pharisaic-system had-categorically-excluded); the second-son-substance saying *I go, sir* (Greek *egō, kyrie* — the *Lord, Lord* substance per Matthew 7:21) and-walking-not (the chief-priests-and-elders walking the substance of saying-yes-without-doing); the substance directly ties to Matthew 7:21-23 *not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven* and to *Torah-lessness* (Greek *anomia* — Torah-less-walking) the King names — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the repentance-and-hypocrisy architecture. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 17:24 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *to-them-that-repent-he-granted-them-return* substance (*but to them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience*) the first-son-substance walks; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 1:28 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *double-heart* substance (*distrust not the fear of Yahuah (God) when you are poor: and come not to him with a double heart*) the second-son-substance walks; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 1:29 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the be-not-a-hypocrite-in-the-sight-of-men substance (*be not an hypocrite in the sight of men, and take good heed what you speak*) — the Greek *hypokritēs* the King uses against the Pharisees throughout the gospel (Matt 6:2, 6:5, 6:16, 15:7, 22:18, 23:13-29, 24:51) the wisdom-stream-substance had-named the architecture-of; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 21:1 names the *ask-pardon-for-your-former-sins* substance (*my son, have you sinned? do so no more, but ask pardon for your former sins*) the Yochanan (John)-baptism-substance walked-out at the wilderness-pericope; 2 Esdras 9:11 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the leadership-substance's despising-the-substance-of-repentance the Father-substance-had-opened (*and they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open to them, understood not, but despised it*) — the substance the chief-priests-and-elders walking-the-second-son's-substance carries. The framework reads the cluster per Red Line #2 + Red Line #10 + the *Torah-lessness* substance — the substance the wisdom-stream-corpus carries at the substance-of-the-doing-against-the-saying is the substance the apostolic-Paul-letters carry at Romans 2:13 (*not the hearers of the law are just before Elohim (God), but the doers of the law shall be justified*) + the apostolic-James-letter carries throughout (1:22 + 2:14-26) + the apostolic-Yochanan-letter carries at 1 John 2:3-4 (*hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments*) — the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates at the substance the publicans-and-harlots-substance walked-into-and-the-leadership-substance walked-against.

threads.title: The wicked husbandmen — prophets slain, house desolate, corrupt shepherds judged, and the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) gathered as from the beginning
threads.summary_md: The vineyard is Isaiah's, the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) which is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and the husbandmen who beat and kill the owner's servants are the men entrusted with it, the leadership, not the people of the vineyard. The servants are the prophets, and the killing is the pattern the whole Tanakh records. Ezra heard the Father name it: *I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands* (2 Esdras 1:32), and name its consequence: *your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble* (2 Esdras 1:33), which is what Yahusha (Jesus) says to the city at the end of chapter 23 and shows the disciples at the start of chapter 24. Last of all the owner sends his son, and the crowd itself pronounces the sentence: *They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.* (Matthew 21:41). Enoch watched that sentence carried out in the dream of the sheep. The Lord of the sheep handed his flock to seventy shepherds with a count of how many might be destroyed, *And I saw till those shepherds pastured in their season, and they began to slay and to destroy more than they were bidden, and they delivered those sheep into the hand of the lions.* (1 Enoch 89:65), and in the end *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). Then comes the verse the pulpit turned into replacement: *the kingdom of Elohim (God) shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.* A nation, one, singular in the Greek. Not the Gentile church in place of Yashar'el (Israel); the stewardship taken from the men who held it and given to the fruit-bearing remnant of both houses, gathered as the prophets said. Sirach prayed for exactly that: *gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (Ecclesiasticus 36:11). The stone the builders rejected becomes the head of the corner, and the vineyard goes to the tribes brought home.

threads.title: The wedding feast and the garments of the righteous — 2 Esdras 2 and Wisdom of Solomon 5's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 22:1-14
threads.summary_md: Matt 22:1-14's parable-of-the-marriage-feast — the kingdom-banquet the King-substance walks-out against the leadership-stewards the prior chapter's husbandmen-parable had named — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gathered-to-the-feast / great-people-upon-Mount-Tsion / young-man-of-high-stature-setting-crowns / glorious-kingdom-and-beautiful-crown substance. Four moves: 2 Esdras 2:38 names the wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gathered *in the feast of Yahuah (God)* substance the King's servants-walking-into-the-highways-and-hedges at Matt 22:9 brings into-effect; 2 Esdras 2:42 names the great-people-upon-Mount-Tsion the wedding-feast-furnished-with-guests at Matt 22:10 walks-out; 2 Esdras 2:43 names the young-man-of-high-stature setting-crowns-upon-the-gathered the king-substance-walking-among-the-guests at Matt 22:11 walks-out at the historical-pivot; Wisdom of Solomon 5:16 names the glorious-kingdom-and-beautiful-crown the citizen-walking-in-the-wedding-garment receives at Matt 22:12-13 the man-without-the-garment cannot. The framework reads the cluster in continuity with Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes architecture (the highways-and-hedges-gathering is the scattered-seed coming-home per Hosea 1:9-10 + Isaiah 11:11-12 + Ezekiel 37:21 + Zechariah 10:8-10, NOT the categorically-unrelated-nations-grafted-by-faith-confession substance the inherited-Christian-replacement-theology had collapsed-the-substance-into) and in continuity with the post-harvest-sifting-architecture (the wedding-garment is the substance-walked-after-the-door-is-passed-through per Revelation 19:8 + 22:14, NOT the imputed-righteousness-without-substance-walked the Reformation-substance had collapsed-the-gospel-into; the man-without-the-garment cast-into-outer-darkness is the wheat-blotted-out-by-walking-without-fruit per Revelation 3:5 + Matthew 7:21-23, NOT a warning-to-tares the tares had-never-been-written). The wisdom-stream and the apostolic-vision cohere at the gathered-multitude-on-Sion architecture the King's wedding-feast-parable walks-out.

threads.title: Render unto Caesar — Sirach 17 and Wisdom of Solomon's witness to the image-of-Elohim stamped on man at Matt 22:15-22
threads.summary_md: Matt 22:15-22's tribute-to-Caesar pericope — the Pharisees-and-Herodians united-against-the-King at a forced-binary-trap, the Roman-denarius bearing Tiberius Caesar's image-and-superscription, the King's-question *whose is this image and superscription?*, and the King's-answer *render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto Elohim (God) the things that are Elohim's (God's)* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the image-of-Elohim-stamped-on-man and the law-of-life-for-an-heritage substance. Four moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 17:3 names the wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for *he made them according to his image* — Sirach 17 carries the Bereshit (Genesis) 1:26-27 creation-substance forward; Sirach 17:11 names the *law of life for an heritage* substance — the Torah given to the citizen-stamped-with-the-Father's-image as the inheritance (Sirach 24:23 names the architecture explicitly as *the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Ya'aqov (Jacob)*); Wisdom of Solomon 2:23 names the *image of his own eternity* substance — the citizen-stamped-with-the-image-of-Elohim's-own-eternity; Wisdom of Solomon 9:1 names the *made all things with thy word* substance — the same Word the apostle Yochanan (John) walks at John 1:1-3 through-whom-all-things-were-made. The framework reads the cluster carefully. The Greek *eikōn* the King uses at v.20 is the same Septuagint-Greek the Genesis 1:26-27 creation-substance carries; the citizen bears the image of the Father the same way the coin bears the image of Caesar — what is stamped with the Father's-image belongs to the Father. Per Red Line #4: Torah is NOT the curse but the law-of-life-for-an-heritage Sirach 17:11 names the wisdom-stream-substance for. Per the framework's reading of the natural-administration: the King's-answer is NOT the post-Constantinian collapse-of-two-co-equal-spheres; the natural-administration operates under the principalities-and-powers-of-the-darkness (Ephesians 6:12) the Father permits-for-an-age, with the categorical-precedence the apostle Kefa (Peter) walked-out at Acts 5:29 when the natural-administration-walks-against-the-Father (the Tanakh-pattern of Shadrakh (Shadrach) + Meishakh (Meshach) + Aved-Nego (Abed-nego) at Daniel 3, Daniel at Daniel 6, the prophet Eliyahu (Elijah) at 1 Kings 18, the apostle Yochanan (John)'s apocalyptic-vision at Revelation 13's beast-and-mark substance). The wisdom-stream had named the image-architecture; the King brings the substance into-the-Pharisaic-and-Herodian-system's-face at the tribute-coin.

threads.title: The resurrection of the righteous — 2 Maccabees 7's mother and seven sons, 2 Esdras and the Wisdom of Solomon beside Matthew 22:23-33
threads.summary_md: The Sadducees, the priestly families who held the temple and denied the resurrection, bring Yahusha (Jesus) a riddle built on the levirate law, seven brothers and one wife, to make the resurrection look absurd. He tells them they err because they know neither the scriptures nor the power of Elohim (God), and he answers from the bush: *I am the Elohim (God) of Avraham (Abraham), and the Elohim (God) of Yitschaq (Isaac), and the Elohim (God) of Ya'aqov (Jacob); Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living.* (Matthew 22:32). The fathers are asleep, not gone, and the one who spoke to Moses still calls himself theirs. His word about the angels is about the angels who stayed in heaven; the ones Enoch writes of left it and took wives, which is the whole reason Genesis 6 and Jude 6 are in the Bible, so the verse is not a rule about every angel that ever was. The martyrs under Antiochus had already confessed what the Sadducees denied. The second of the seven sons told the king that the King of the world would raise them up to everlasting life, because they died for his laws, and their mother told them that the Creator who gave them breath would give it back again (2 Maccabees 7:9, 23). Ezra was shown the same day: *And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.* (2 Esdras 7:32), which is Daniel's word carried forward: *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* (Daniel 12:2). And the Wisdom of Solomon tells where the righteous are in the meantime: *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:1). Read that whole chapter and the shining and the judging of nations it promises belong to the day of their visitation, the resurrection, not to a disembodied soul flying off at the moment of death. The righteous sleep in the Father's keeping and wait for the one who comes to raise them, which is what Paul tells the grieving at Thessalonica, and what John calls the first resurrection. The seven brothers and their mother paid in blood for a hope the Sadducees mocked, and it is the same hope the Sadducees' own scriptures held.

threads.title: Love of Yahuah and love of neighbor as the Shema walked out — Sirach 7, 17, 28 and Wisdom of Solomon 6's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 22:34-40
threads.summary_md: Matt 22:34-40's great-commandment question — the Pharisaic-lawyer-substance (*nomikos* — the Torah-specialist) tempting the King with the rabbinic-ranking-game over the 613 mitzvot; the King's Shema-citation of Devarim (Deuteronomy) 6:4-5 plus the Vayikra (Leviticus) 19:18 love-thy-neighbor substance; and the closing *on these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets* (Greek *krematai* — suspension-from-a-load-bearing-point, NOT the substance-of-replacement-of-the-Torah-by-the-two) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the love-Yahuah-with-all-thy-strength + commandment-concerning-the-neighbor + forgive-and-remember-the-covenant + love-is-the-keeping-of-her-laws substance. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 7:30 names THE direct verbal-anchor for *love him that made you with all your strength* — the Shema-substance of Devarim (Deuteronomy) 6:5 carried-forward at the wisdom-stream-register; Sirach 17:14 names THE direct verbal-anchor for *every man commandment concerning his neighbour* — the Leviticus 19:18 substance carried-forward and named-explicitly as the Father giving-every-man-commandment-concerning-his-neighbor from-the-beginning; Sirach 28:2 names the forgive-your-neighbor substance the King will-walk at Matt 6:14-15 and the unforgiving-servant parable at Matt 18:23-35; Sirach 28:7 names the remember-the-commandments-and-the-covenant substance — binding-the-commandments-and-the-covenant together in one substance, the same architecture the King walks at Matt 22:40 (the two-commandments and the Torah-and-the-prophets are one-substance); Wisdom of Solomon 6:18 names *love is the keeping of her laws* — the same substance the apostle Yochanan (John) names explicitly at 1 John 5:2-3 (*this is the love of Elohim (God), that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous*). The framework reads the cluster in continuity with the heart-Torah-architecture of Jeremiah 31:31-34 + Ezekiel 36:26-27 + Devarim (Deuteronomy) 30:6 + Devarim 11:1 + Micah 6:8 + Hosea 6:6 — the love-of-the-Father and the keeping-of-the-commandments are one-substance walked-out from-the-inside through the new-heart-and-new-spirit. Per Red Line #4: Torah is NOT the curse; per Red Line #5: love-of-Father is NOT pitted against Torah; per Red Line #6: the Spirit is NOT separated from Torah. The wisdom-stream had walked the substance centuries before the King brings it into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face in the Temple-court; the apostolic-restatement at Romans 13:8-10 (*love is the fulfilling of the law*) + Galatians 5:14 + James 2:8 + 1 John 4:20-21 + 1 John 5:2-3 carries the substance forward. The substance is NOT the post-Reformation collapse-of-the-Torah-into-the-two; the substance is the Torah-and-the-prophets as the detailed-walking-out of love-of-Father and love-of-neighbor in the substantive life of the citizen-of-the-kingdom.

threads.title: The Elect One at the right hand — the Parables of Enoch beside David's Lord at Matthew 22:41-46
threads.summary_md: *Saying, What think ye of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David. He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Adonai (Lord), saying, Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool? If David then call him Adonai (Lord), how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:42-45). Nobody in the temple could answer him, and from that day no one dared ask him another question. The question stands on two Lords in one verse. The first is Yahuah, the Father who has no form. The second is the one David bows to, and he sits at the Father's right hand because the Father seats him there. Enoch saw this before David wrote it. He saw an old one with a head of days, and beside him another whose face was like a man's, and asked who he was: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). This Son of Adam is older than David's line, older than the stars: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). And the throne is given, not seized: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3); *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). Put the psalm and the Parables side by side and the answer to the temple's riddle is plain. The son of David is greater than David because he was named before the Head of Days before David's house existed, and he is not the Father, because the Father is the one who names him and seats him. He was hidden from the beginning and shown to the elect: *For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.* (1 Enoch 62:7). John says the same thing in his first line: *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* (John 1:1). So the Son is not a creature made at a point in time, and he is not the Father wearing another face, and he is not one of three equals; he is the Father's own form, brought forth from him and seated by him, which is why the whole apostolic witness keeps coming back to this psalm, from Peter at Pentecost to Hebrews to the Revelation.

threads.title: The pride-and-religious-status architecture — Sirach's wisdom-stream witness to the kingdom-inversion the King walks-against at Matt 23:1-12

threads.title: The corrupted priesthood and the proselyte made twofold — Testament of Levi, 1 Enoch 99, Wisdom of Solomon beside Matthew 23:13-22
threads.summary_md: The first three woes are aimed at a priesthood. They shut up the kingdom of heaven against men and will not go in themselves, they split hairs over which oath binds and which does not, and in between those two stands the woe that names what the whole system was doing: *Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.* (Matthew 23:15). The proselyte was told that becoming a Yahudi (Jew) by the rite would save him, and then he was handed a Torah buried under traditions that voided it, so he ended up worse off than the men who made him. Paul fights the same gospel in Galatia a generation later, and it is still being preached today under other names, wherever a system tells a man that joining it is salvation and then teaches him against the commandments. Enoch had already described the men who do this: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 99:2). Perverting the words of uprightness while transgressing the eternal law is the proselyte-maker's trade exactly, and the man he makes is transformed into what he was not. The Testament of Levi had warned the priests themselves that they would deal lawlessly with Yashar'el (Israel) until the veil of the temple was rent, and that the priests of the last times would be idolaters, adulterers, lovers of money, proud and lawless, and the Wisdom of Solomon tells the ministers of the kingdom that they will be judged because they did not judge aright nor keep the law. The test is the same one John gives: whoever says he knows him and does not keep his commandments is a liar. Hold that against any priesthood, in any age, and the woes find their mark. The mark is the system, not the people under it. The King speaking the woes is himself a Yahudi (Jew), so are the apostles, so are the crowds in front of him, and the chapter ends not with their rejection but with his lament over the children he would have gathered.

threads.title: Swearing and the faithful yes-and-nay — Sirach's wisdom-stream witness to the third-woe at Matt 23:16-22
